name: About
body:
Hi, this is R.
Welcome to my Art Project, coping mechanism, side hustle, hobby, time, money, and energy investment sample register.

Seattle, 2024; what began as a quiet exploration evolved through jewelry school @PRATT, and many looong hours of experimentation at my little home studio, a space where ideas take shape.

Tons of local markets, many unique individual pieces, and looots of human support; today, an artistic collective, @Siderail, welcomed me to nourish and inspire my practice, and I'll keep going.

Jewelry, for me, is a form of **representation**: every piece is a little story, a feeling, a *fragment of identity*.

Love,
Rhina Navas,
R.
